visual_review: All six colour previews inspected; source series retain every plotted sample and real gaps. No smoothing or value clipping. Full matrix blanks correspond only to no completed runs.
reviewed_warnings: F08 heading RMSE label lies within blank space inside the bounding rectangle of a rasterized line artist, but it covers no trajectory. PDF geometry flags image-edge overlap because it cannot inspect the white pixels. This was visually checked.
Static source-width parser misreads 174/25.4; final PDF media boxes correspond to exactly 174 mm.
All F07 log-axis samples are explicitly asserted finite and strictly positive. Full-matrix LogNorm inputs are the finite positive saved RMSE values.
Family cells are descriptive medians of registered variants of the same measured route, with all per-case outcomes provided. No confidence interval or independent-field-trial claim is made.
Rotated heatmap labels passed final-PDF collision and page-clipping checks.
data_boundaries: Semisynthetic observed-data replay, no demonstrated online hardware-in-loop.
Core nine variants may differ by random seed, placement, or ineffective seed, as specified by registry.
A1 total GNSS loss pauses auxiliary updates; it is not a pure heading factorial.
Source-weighting extra completions remain outside the 513 joint-finite distributions.
Literature reading screenshots are local review material and must not be copied into the GitHub package.
